prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE production SOURCE ATLAS containing 8 isolated vocabulary cutouts for MaiPace. Image 1 is the Phố giấy STYLE REFERENCE: watercolor/gouache pigment, delicate dark pencil marks, subtle paper grain INSIDE painted shapes, softened natural shapes, ivory/sand/charcoal/sage and muted brick-red. Image 2 is ONLY cutout finish reference; do not reproduce book. Canvas precisely 2048 x 1024 pixels, landscape 2:1, laid out as FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, 8 equal 512x512 cells. TRUE native transparent RGBA background THROUGHOUT all blank spaces and within open holes; no paper background, scene, floor, cast shadow or drawn checkerboard. No visible grid, panels, border, labels, writing, letters, numerals, kanji/kana, symbols, logos, watermark or UI anywhere, including product surfaces. One complete object centered in EACH exact cell, occupying 65-70% of that cell long dimension, generous identical margins of at least 64px, nothing touches/crosses cell boundaries. Keep all 8 fully contained and independent with similar pigment detail. Not photographs, glossy3D, flatvector or thickcartoon. Reading order fixed left-to-right: TOP ROW cells 1 through 4; BOTTOM ROW cells 5 through 8. Subjects:
1. a single silver compact disc, round with central open transparent hole, softly iridescent surface, no case, no writing
2. a single charcoal flat-screen television on simple low stand, blank softly gray screen, three-quarter front view, no remote or writing
3. a single portable ivory and charcoal radio, clearly visible speaker grille and two round knobs, simple unnumbered tuner strip, short aerial, no writing
4. a single open charcoal and warm silver laptop, blank ivory screen, keyboard painted as small unlettered key shapes, three-quarter view, no writing
5. a single muted brick-red compact car, complete front and side three-quarter view, all body and visible wheels intact, blank plates and no writing
6. a single brown chocolate bar with recognizable chocolate squares, half inside plain ivory and muted brick-red wrapper, no writing or logos
7. a single small closed personal planner, sand-brown leather cover, charcoal elastic closure and one brick-red ribbon bookmark, ivory page edge, not spiral binding, no writing
8. a single thin soft-cover magazine, slightly open showing thin flexible paper, cover has one simple sage botanical illustration and blank sand field, no spine thickness, no text or glyphs
Important: one object per cell with silhouette and identity unmistakable; do not combine neighboring objects or add decorative extras. This is an export master to be split into independent transparent files; accurate equal grid placement and EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTERS are essential.

suggestedAlt.vi: Một chiếc ô tô nhỏ màu đỏ gạch với bốn bánh.
